about: Problem 9 full run over tickets 101-103 (the second full run, 2026-10-14): what each ticket ended as, who did what, and every human decision. Built from output/audit_trail.json and data/campus_customs_new.db.

run.status_rule: A ticket is resolved when the shop's part is done: every request it needed is decided by a human and a saved draft matches those decisions. A delivery or a customer's reply may still be to come (backend/prompts/boss.md, section 10).

earlier_run.note: The first full run left 101 and 103 in_progress under the old closing rule, and its approvals were clicked by Claude Code on the approver's instruction. The database was reset and every ticket rerun for this run.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: Size S was out of stock (0 on hand, 1 needed). Invoice 501 ($840.00, 3 days overdue) was paid so Bulldog Print Co would ship again, and a 1-tee restock (PO 1, $8.00) was ordered, arriving 2026-09-05 at the earliest. Draft 1 to Tauhid Zaman is on the board, not sent. Resolved: the shop's part is done.

Boss.contribution: Read the ticket and asked Inventory, then Accounting, then Customer Service. Re-read the ticket and set waiting_approval with approvals 1-2 and draft 1. In the close run it worked alone: it read approvals 1 and 2 as approved and PO 1 as ordered, and set resolved.

Inventory.contribution: Found CC-TEE-WHITE size S at 0 on hand against 1 needed (M 5, L 3, XL 2 in stock). Found the restock vendor Bulldog Print Co (5 lead days, earliest arrival 2026-09-05), blocked by unpaid invoice 501 ($840.00, 3 days overdue).

Accounting.contribution: Checked cash ($3,400.00, nothing pending) and re-read invoice 501. Filed approval 1 (pay invoice 501, $840.00) and PO 1 / approval 2 (1 × CC-TEE-WHITE S at $8.00, which can't be approved until 501 is paid). Reported $848.00 pending, leaving $2,552.00.

Customer Service.contribution: Saved draft 1 to Tauhid Zaman: size S is out of stock, a restock is being arranged with timing to be confirmed, and M, L or XL are offered only with the customer's agreement. Not sent.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: 8 of the 20 size M hoodies are in stock. A bulk price of $49.00 each for 20 ($980.00) was approved. The 12-hoodie restock ($264.00) was rejected because only $152.00 was left after rent, invoice 501 and the $8.00 tee order, so a separate $49.00 price for the 8 in stock ($392.00) was filed and approved. Draft 4 offers Yale AI Club those 8 at $49.00 each; drafts 2 and 3 are superseded. Resolved: the shop's part is done.

Boss.contribution: Read the ticket and asked Inventory, Accounting and Customer Service. Set waiting_approval with approvals 4 and 5, noting that PO 2 depended on approval 1 (ticket 101) and that all pending requests were $112.00 more than checking; it left the payment order to the human. In close run 1 it asked Inventory, Accounting and Customer Service again and set waiting_approval on approval 6. In close run 2 it asked Customer Service for a final draft and set resolved.

Inventory.contribution: Found 8 of 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY size M on hand (short 12; S 4, L 14, XL 6 in stock). Found the restock vendor, Bulldog Print Co, blocked by invoice 501; 12 more would cost $264.00. In close run 1 it confirmed 8 M on hand and that the restock was rejected.

Accounting.contribution: Filed approval 4: a price override of $49.00 × 20 ($980.00 quote; 15.5% off the $58.00 list price, $27.00 margin a unit). Filed PO 2 / approval 5: 12 × size M at $22.00 = $264.00, blocked by invoice 501. It tried to request invoice 501's payment again; the server refused the duplicate (approval 1 already covered it). Reported that all pending requests were $112.00 more than checking. In close run 1 it filed approval 6: $49.00 × 8 ($392.00 quote, no cash), because approval 4 covered 20 units.

Customer Service.contribution: Saved draft 2 (8 in stock, restock being arranged, quote under review). In close run 1 it saved draft 3 (8 in stock, no restock, no price while approval 6 was pending). In close run 2 it saved draft 4: 8 size M at the approved $49.00 each ($392.00), the other 12 cannot be supplied, and other sizes only with the club's agreement. None was sent.
